case_title: JUAN HERNANDEZ GOMEZ VS. GABRIEL CASTELLANOS

docket_entries.description: REQUEST THAT CLERK ENTER JUDGMENT ON FINAL ORDER, DECISION OR AWARD OF THE LABOR COMMISSIONER FILED BY PLAINTIFF GOMEZ, JUAN HERNANDEZ AS TO DEFENDANT CASTELLANOS, GABRIEL AN INDIVIDUAL JUDICIAL COUNCIL CIVIL CASE COVER SHEET FILED
